name: Students in vocational education and training
description:
This dataset contains data on the distribution of students in vocational education and training programs by level of education. The default table displays data for the latest available year. The selection can be changed to display data: by year and by sex.

Data for the latest available year are preliminary. Final data will be released on 29 September 2026.

For more information, please consult the Education at a Glance web page and the OECD Handbook for Internationally Comparative Education Statistics: Concepts, Standards, Definitions and Classifications.

dims.name: Country
dims.def: Country or geographic area to which the measured statistical phenomenon relates

dims.name: Education program
dims.def: An ordered set which groups and classifies education programs according to the knowledge, skills, competencies and qualifications which they are designed to impart

dims.name: Indicator
dims.def: Entity for which information is sought and for which statistics are ultimately compiled

dims.name: Education type
names: Formal education, includes formal initial and formal adult education programs
dims.def: Determines whether education programs cover formal initial and/or formal adult education

dims.name: Field of study
dims.def: Fields of education based on ISCED 2013

dims.name: Grade
dims.def: Indicates the specific stage, class or year of instruction within the ISCED level in initial education

dims.name: Frequency of observation
dims.def: Time interval at which observations occur over a given time period

code_defs.A:
To be used for data collected or disseminated
						every year

dims.name: Origin
dims.def: Country of origin of statistical units

dims.name: Mobility
dims.def: Measures transfers between education systems (such transfers include the physical crossing of a border)

dims.name: Measured as
names: Percentage of the same student group
dims.def: Unit in which the data values are expressed

dims.name: Sex
dims.def: State of being male or female

dims.name: Age
dims.def: Length of time that an entity has lived or existed

source_notes: Shares in this table are taken within the group the breakdowns define: the denominator has the same sex, age and other characteristics as the figure itself, not the population as a whole.

Regional rows such as OECD, EU27 and G7 are compiled from whichever member countries reported that particular figure in that particular year, so what they cover changes between one selection and the next. Two things follow. A breakdown can exceed the total it belongs to, because the two are built from different sets of countries. And a count for a region can come out far too small, because only some members reported it. Compare countries directly where the question allows it; read the regional rows as a rough centre of gravity rather than as a measurement of the region.
